title: Verify: BootScene state sync and objectClick forwarding
summary: Unit tests for sync on store change and click emission
description: With buildScene mocked to return fake objects, assert sync and objectClick behavior.
acceptance_criteria: onStateChange syncs new state and ignores null
technical_constraints: Real useGameStore with setState; phaserToReact spied; same mocks as bootSceneBuild.test.ts

steps.action: Mock phaser, buildScene (returns one fake object {sync, destroy, onInteract: vi.fn()}), buildEffects, playSceneTransition, renderContext. Set useGameStore state to createInitialState(world, scene) from '@game/state/gameState'; create(); assert sync called with that state. Then setState to a second state, call boot.onStateChange(), assert sync called with the second. Then setState({state:null}), call onStateChange(), assert call count unchanged.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneSync.test.ts -t 'sync'

steps.action: vi.spyOn(phaserToReact, 'emit'); after create(), take the callback passed to the fake object's onInteract and invoke it with {objectId:'abc', actions:[]}; assert emit called with ('objectClick', {id:'abc'}).
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneSync.test.ts
steps.expected: All tests in the file pass
